title: New stacking raid farm in development
summary: A lag issue affecting the upcoming stacking raid farm was fixed ahead of its planned release.
description: Work continued on a fast stacking raid farm using calibrated sculk sensors after a high-drop-rate lag problem was resolved.

body.text: A performance problem caused by the farm's high drop rates was identified and fixed.
The upcoming farm uses calibrated sculk sensors as part of its high-speed design.
